title: Hooks 信任与生命周期中心

originalAcceptance.criterion: 未信任或变更后的 hook 默认不执行。
UI 和 host-api 能列出来源、hash、状态、managed。
信任/禁用变更写审计事件，并有单测与 E2E。

boundaries: Workspace hooks require explicit trust and an exact hash pin; changed or untrusted code is not registered.
Bundled/managed/plugin hooks remain owner-managed and cannot be disabled from the user UI.
Main uses a lightweight HOOK.md scan plus the shared pure trust resolver to avoid bundling the runtime discovery graph.
No second hook runtime, event vocabulary or marketplace was added.
All receipts are agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
